escena: SCENE (cinematic, Hollywood blockbuster still, the start line of a technology race inside a dark hangar-like studio at night): she (the woman of the references, her face exactly as in the references) stands UPRIGHT at the start line in a confident athletic ready stance, one foot slightly forward, fists loose, shoulders squared to camera, framed from the waist up on the RIGHT half of the frame, a heroic medium shot. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: the camera is about two meters away at chest height with an 85mm lens, so nothing is foreshortened and she does not lean toward the lens; her head is in natural proportion to her athletic body, the head occupies about one quarter of the frame height, her shoulders are clearly wider than two head-widths, the torso and arms read full and strong. She wears a sleek, form-fitting BIONIC SUIT in deep navy with matte white armored plates on the shoulders, chest and forearms, thin glowing azure-blue (#0375DB) light seams along the plates; the chest plate is plain, smooth white with NO emblem, NO logo, NO symbol, NO rocket, NO lettering. She wears sleek futuristic wraparound glasses with CLEAR TRANSPARENT lenses lightly tinted azure blue, a thin frameless edge and a fine glowing azure line along the top of the lenses; her eyes are clearly visible through the transparent lenses, no mirror reflection covers her eyes. She looks straight into the lens with a fearless, confident half-smile, razor-thin focus on her eyes behind the lenses. Behind her, far and out of focus, a row of five round azure start lights hangs in the haze, all lit. Around her, a squad of five small friendly robot agents, each the size of a football, round glossy white bodies with navy panels and big expressive azure-blue LED eyes, with comic, cheerful faces, and she has no watch, no bracelet and no ring: one sits on her shoulder pumping a tiny fist, one crouches in a sprinter's starting stance on a ledge in the soft foreground, one wears tiny racing goggles, one gives a thumbs-up, one is caught mid-jump with excitement, all clearly ready to race with her; the robots stay small, never larger than her head. Their LED eyes, the start lights and her suit seams are the only blue light sources; a hard key light from the left sculpts her face; volumetric haze and a cool rim light behind; anamorphic flares kept subtle. The LEFT half of the frame is calm, dark, empty studio space with soft haze and no objects. No readable text anywhere.
